title: Directory backup adapter: report a temporary file left behind when the no-replace move fails
outcome: Directory backup adapter: report a temporary file left behind when the no-replace move fails
acceptance: When persist_noclobber fails in the directory adapter's publish (an existing final name, a non-retryable error, or sharing violations past the retries), the temporary file is removed with the bounded retry, and a removal that fails is reported as backup Leftover beside the primary error with its code kept; a test in the repository covers a failed move followed by a failed removal
